tool_args.rationale: The pilot reaches s_grad = 2.44, below the proposed onset range of 2.50–2.68. The smooth and threshold-avalanche models therefore make identical pilot predictions. The high-gradient probe is the lowest-cost targeted way to test whether the response departs from the smooth law above threshold.

considered_alternatives.option: Smooth siphon with a square-root branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot is consistent with this model but cannot establish that the smooth law continues above the proposed threshold.
All pilot gradients are below the proposed threshold range, so the onset and loss coefficient are unidentifiable.
It costs more and is less directly targeted at crossing the proposed gradient threshold.
